name: right-hud-menu-uniform-grid
description: Verify Inventory, Shop, Pets, and Quests use one equal-size right-HUD icon grid with aligned rows, columns, and gaps.

args.code:
-- BEGIN RIGHT MENU GEOMETRY ASSERTIONS
local function verifyRightMenu(h,profile)
 assert(profile=='Desktop','uniform right-menu flow requires the actual desktop profile')
 local names={'InventoryButton','ShopButton','PetsButton','QuestsButton','RebirthButton'}
 local buttons={}
 local hp,hs=h.AbsolutePosition,h.AbsoluteSize
 local expectedNarrow=82*math.min(hs.X/1672,hs.Y/941)<44
 local expectedLayout=expectedNarrow and 'NarrowDesktopUniformIconGridV1' or 'UniformIconGridV1'
 assert(h:GetAttribute('RightMenuLayoutMode')==expectedLayout,'right-menu layout metadata disagrees with actual viewport')
 local function near(a,b)return math.abs(a-b)<=1 end
 local function overlap(a,b)
  local p,s,q,t=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize
  return math.max(0,math.min(p.X+s.X,q.X+t.X)-math.max(p.X,q.X))*math.max(0,math.min(p.Y+s.Y,q.Y+t.Y)-math.max(p.Y,q.Y))
 end
 local minTarget=math.huge
 for _,name in ipairs(names)do
  local button=assert(h:FindFirstChild(name),'missing menu '..name)
  assert(button:IsA('ImageButton') and button.Active and button.Selectable,'menu is not an active selectable button '..name)
  local node=button while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject')then assert(node.Visible,'hidden menu '..name)end node=node.Parent end
  local p,s=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
  minTarget=math.min(minTarget,s.X,s.Y)
  assert(math.min(s.X,s.Y)>=44,'menu below actual 44px target '..name)
  local margin=expectedNarrow and 12 or 0
  assert(p.X>=hp.X+margin-1 and p.Y>=hp.Y+margin-1 and p.X+s.X<=hp.X+hs.X-margin+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=hp.Y+hs.Y-margin+1,'menu outside safe host '..name)
  for _,other in ipairs(buttons)do assert(overlap(button,other)<1,'menu buttons overlap')end
  table.insert(buttons,button)
 end
 local inventory,shop,pets,quests,rebirth=table.unpack(buttons)
 local sameSize=inventory.Size==shop.Size and shop.Size==pets.Size and pets.Size==quests.Size
 local sameRenderedSize=true
 for i=2,4 do sameRenderedSize=sameRenderedSize and near(buttons[i].AbsoluteSize.X,inventory.AbsoluteSize.X) and near(buttons[i].AbsoluteSize.Y,inventory.AbsoluteSize.Y)end
 local sameTop=near(inventory.AbsolutePosition.Y,shop.AbsolutePosition.Y)
 local sameColumn=near(shop.AbsolutePosition.X,pets.AbsolutePosition.X) and near(pets.AbsolutePosition.X,quests.AbsolutePosition.X)
 local horizontalGap=shop.AbsolutePosition.X-inventory.AbsolutePosition.X-inventory.AbsoluteSize.X
 local shopPetsGap=pets.AbsolutePosition.Y-shop.AbsolutePosition.Y-shop.AbsoluteSize.Y
 local petsQuestsGap=quests.AbsolutePosition.Y-pets.AbsolutePosition.Y-pets.AbsoluteSize.Y
 local evenGaps=horizontalGap>=0 and shopPetsGap>=0 and petsQuestsGap>=0 and near(shopPetsGap,petsQuestsGap)
 assert(sameSize and sameRenderedSize and sameTop and sameColumn and evenGaps,'right-menu uniform grid geometry disagrees')
 if expectedNarrow then
  local height=48*111/87
  assert(h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconSize')==('48x%.6f'):format(height) and h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconGap')==4,'narrow menu declared geometry changed')
  assert(h:GetAttribute('RightMenuRenderedWidth')==48 and math.abs(h:GetAttribute('RightMenuRenderedHeight')-height)<.00001 and h:GetAttribute('RightMenuSafeMargin')==12,'narrow menu actual metadata missing')
  assert(near(inventory.AbsoluteSize.X,48) and near(inventory.AbsoluteSize.Y,height) and near(rebirth.AbsoluteSize.X,48) and near(rebirth.AbsoluteSize.Y,48*111/82),'narrow menu lost authored icon ratios')
  assert(near(horizontalGap,4) and near(shopPetsGap,4) and near(petsQuestsGap,4),'narrow menu must use equal 4px gaps')
 else
  assert(h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconSize')=='87x111' and h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconGap')==3,'wide reference geometry changed')
 end
 return {ok=true,layout=expectedLayout,declaredSize=h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconSize'),declaredGap=h:GetAttribute('RightMenuIconGap'),sameSize=sameSize,sameRenderedSize=sameRenderedSize,sameTop=sameTop,sameColumn=sameColumn,evenGaps=evenGaps,horizontalGap=horizontalGap,shopPetsGap=shopPetsGap,petsQuestsGap=petsQuestsGap,minTarget=minTarget,safeBounds=true,allFiveTargets=true,viewportWidth=hs.X,viewportHeight=hs.Y}
end
-- END RIGHT MENU GEOMETRY ASSERTIONS
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local h=g:WaitForChild('PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD') return H:JSONEncode(verifyRightMenu(h,g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile')))

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseMenus') task.wait(.2)
local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local button=assert(h:FindFirstChild('InventoryButton'))
assert(h.Visible and button.Visible and button.Active and button.Selectable and button:IsDescendantOf(g),'native menu target unavailable')
local p0,size=button.AbsolutePosition,button.AbsoluteSize
local safe,sizeSafe=h.AbsolutePosition,h.AbsoluteSize
assert(size.X>=44 and size.Y>=44 and p0.X>=safe.X-1 and p0.Y>=safe.Y-1 and p0.X+size.X<=safe.X+sizeSafe.X+1 and p0.Y+size.Y<=safe.Y+sizeSafe.Y+1,'native menu hitbox is small or clipped')
local center=p0+size*.5
local hit=p.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(center.X,center.Y)[1]
assert(hit==button or (hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(button)),'native menu target is covered')
g:SetAttribute('RightMenuNativeExpected','InventoryButton')
g:SetAttribute('RightMenuNativeActivated','')
g:SetAttribute('RightMenuNativeActivationCount',0)
button.Activated:Once(function()
 if button.Parent and g:GetAttribute('RightMenuNativeExpected')=='InventoryButton' then
  g:SetAttribute('RightMenuNativeActivated','InventoryButton')
  g:SetAttribute('RightMenuNativeActivationCount',(g:GetAttribute('RightMenuNativeActivationCount') or 0)+1)
 end
end)
return H:JSONEncode({ready=true,target=button.Name,width=size.X,height=size.Y,topmost=true})
